title: The Mystery of the Girl in Red's Treasure
description: You have heard people from various corners weigh in on who the strongest fighter in Mondstadt is, but have yet to get a definite answer. Outside the Knights headquarters, you have an unexpected meeting with one of the candidates for the title — Klee, who is in dire need of help to recover her stolen treasure.

mainQuestExcel.title: The Mystery of the Girl in Red's Treasure
mainQuestExcel.description: You have heard people from various corners weigh in on who the strongest fighter in Mondstadt is, but have yet to get a definite answer. Outside the Knights headquarters, you have an unexpected meeting with one of the candidates for the title — Klee, who is in dire need of help to recover her stolen treasure.

flow.stepDescription: Find the treasure trove in the Whispering Woods

dialogs.text: We're here! This is the place!
Look, this is where my huuuge treasure was buried...
And where there's now a huuuge empty hole in the ground...
Wait — who's that over there?
It's... an Abyss Mage!? Hey, maybe he's the one Jean was warning us about.
What's that in his hand?
My treasure!
Hmph! I see the little girl's brought her friends with her! Time for a change of plan...
Hey, you! If you think you're so tough, get back here and fight!
After him!

flow.stepDescription: Chase down the Abyss Mage with Klee (If the Abyss Mage gets more than 50m away, the quest will be failed)

dialogs.text: Game's up. Now hand it over!
Grr...
You fools think I would give this up so easily after what I have been through to acquire it?
Hehe...
Freeze!
*panting* That girl's lucky she didn't come alone, otherwise I'd...
Hmph...
A gateway to a domain! The Abyss Mage must have snuck inside.
Then he has no way out.
*panting* ...
Klee, do you need a rest?
Why don't you wait here while we get your treasure back for you?
...No, I'm coming with you!
It's my treasure that Mr. Fluffball stole, and it's up to me to get it back!
I admire your courage.
Hee-hee, don't worry. Klee is a big girl!
#Come on, {F#Miss}{M#Mr.} Honorary Knight! Let's goooo!
But these domains can be dangerous.
Let's keep up the chase.

flow.stepDescription: Explore the domain and find the Abyss Mage

dialogs.text: Hmph. You followed me. I must say, I'm impressed.
But this is as far as you will get.
Oh yeah? What are you gonna do?
Mwuhahaha! Ahahahaha!
Oh, the human proclivity to gossip has provided us with everything we need...
We learned that your little red friend had in her possession the most powerful treasure in all of Mondstadt.
That treasure is now in my hands. There is nothing you can do!
Now your precious treasure shall be your undoing!
No, no, wait! D—Don't touch it!
Hah! Oh, how you fret now your predicament is finally clear to you!
Now, what have we here — a flame symbol? Mwuhahaha...
*bang*
NO!
I broke the survival rules... "Explosions can hurt people... Jean can be dreadful..."
This is it... This time I'm done for... *sobs*
Wait, so Klee's treasure is a bomb!?
That was epic...
No wonder Klee was rumored to be the strongest fighter in Mondstadt.
Paimon for one is never picking a fight with her. Ever.
Hold on... Why has she gone and run off?
Something to do with the survival rules...
Seems like it!
Well then, let's head to the <color=#00E1FFFF>Knights' headquarters</color> and report to Jean.
Something to do with Jean...
It made short work of that Abyss Mage!
